auth_rejected.title: Larnitech ({title}): the API key was rejected
auth_rejected.description: The controller is reachable but refuses this API key. Check that the key still matches the one in LT_Setup, and that the API is switched on for this controller — a disabled API is rejected the same way a wrong key is. Home Assistant keeps retrying in the background, so this clears itself as soon as the controller accepts the key again.

mass_device_removal.title: Larnitech ({title}): more than half of the known devices disappeared

confirm.title: Remove the missing Larnitech devices?
confirm.description: {missing} of {total} previously-known devices are absent from the last `get-devices` snapshot on "{title}" — far more than a single device dropping off. This is more often a controller/network hiccup, a misconfigured object, or the wrong server than a real mass removal. Confirm only if you're sure these devices are actually gone from Larnitech; otherwise leave this unconfirmed and check the connection first — the issue clears on its own once a normal snapshot comes back.
